## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Chánglíng Shǒuzhuó* — a one-juan Northern-Sòng / Southern-Sòng transitional Chán *yǔlù* of [Chánglíng Shǒuzhuó](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%88%E5%8D%93) 長靈守卓 (1065–1123), the Línjì-Yángqí master at Chánglíng 長靈. Compiled by his dharma-heir [Jièchén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%8B%E8%AB%B6) 介諶.

One-juan Southern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1347. Shǒuzhuó's dates: 1065–1123; dharma-heir of [Bǎofēng Kèwén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%8B%E6%96%87) 寶峰克文.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1100; *notAfter* c. 1160 (compilation-horizon).
